description: MOVED - this adapter is now published as co.silverpush:silverpush-admob-adapter:2.0.0. Update your dependency to implementation("co.silverpush:silverpush-admob-adapter:2.0.0"). Version 1.0.1 contains no code; it only forwards to the new coordinate, so an existing build keeps resolving with no change. The new coordinate is a major version: the Parameter configured against the ad source in your AdMob or Ad Manager console is now a key the adapter looks the ad unit up with, rather than the ad unit itself, so the console entry has to be updated as well or the ad source will stop filling.
